_about: The Necropolis of Eternal Night (levels 25-47): the risen dead who answer each other's knell, skeletal legions that patrol the avenues, the necromancer, death knight and banshee as elites, the ancient lich a sub-boss, Morthul the Lich Lord on the Bone Throne raising legion after legion as the night thickens, and Verdraxx the green dragon breathing caustic poison in her lair.

14050.name: morthul lich lord
14050.long_desc: Morthul the Lich Lord sits upon the Bone Throne, a crown of black iron on his fleshless brow.
14050.description: A skeleton in robes of rotted purple and gold, cold blue fire burning where his eyes once were. He built the Necropolis to house an army, and every grave in it is a soldier waiting for his word.

phases.message: Morthul rises from the Bone Throne: "Rise, my legions! RISE!"

abilities.name: Soul Storm
abilities.telegraph: Morthul raises his staff, and screaming souls whirl about the throne!

abilities.name: Finger of Death
abilities.telegraph: Morthul points a bony finger at you!

abilities.name: Power Word: Kill
abilities.telegraph: Morthul begins to speak a word of ending!

796400.name: vaelith ancient vampire
796400.long_desc: Vaelith, an ancient vampire, rises from her obsidian coffin, silk trailing from her shoulders.
796400.description: She is tall and grey-pale, dressed in the faded finery of a court that fell a thousand years ago, and her eyes are the deep red of old wine. She sleeps here through the day among her paintings and tapestries, and goes out at night to feed. Her smile shows the tips of long teeth.
796400.why: the ancient vampire whose mausoleum this is

796401.name: barrow king mummy lord
796401.short_desc: the Barrow King, a mummy lord
796401.long_desc: The Barrow King stands beside his sarcophagus, wrapped in grave-cloth gone black with age.
796401.description: A mummy lord older than the necropolis around him, crowned in tarnished bronze, his grave-cloths painted with the symbols carved on the walls. He was a king of a people no one remembers, and he was buried with a magic meant to keep him sleeping. That magic is failing. Cold pours off him like water.
796401.why: the ancient evil that sleeps in the sarcophagus

796402.name: ghoul packmaster
796402.long_desc: A ghoul packmaster crouches among the gnawed bones, sniffing the air.
796402.description: Bigger and cleverer than the ghouls it leads, this one has long, grey-nailed hands and a hunter's patience. It sets the ambushes in the warren and drags the freshest corpses below.
